events.title: Occidental Tops Q1 Earnings Estimates on Strong Production Volumes
events.body: OXY's Q1 EPS beats estimates on strong production volumes, revenues miss forecasts, and oil & gas contributions fall year over year.

events.title: Devon Energy's Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Coterra Merger on Course
events.body: DVN tops Q1 EPS estimates despite a revenue miss, as production rises and the Coterra merger nears a close.

events.title: Energy Transfer Q1 Earnings Lag Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
events.body: ET's Q1 earnings miss estimates, revenues rise 32.1% and 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance is raised to $18.2-$18.6 billion.

events.title: CNX Q1 Deep Dive: Strong Performance Amid Infrastructure and Demand Trends
events.body: Natural gas producer CNX Resources (NYSE:CNX) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 67.1% year on year to $786.7 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.20 per share was 23.7% above analysts’ consensus
